title: Quantum corrections to symmetron fifth forces for planar sources
summary: We provide a semi-analytic calculation of the first quantum corrections to the symmetron fifth force around a planar source with nonzero thickness. We find a suppression of the fifth force compared with the classical prediction within a Compton wavelength of the source, which is of order 10% in the parameter region relevant to experiments like CANNEX, while the fifth force is enhanced at larger distances from the source.
